changes: p1 Sadāśiva: 'kāśiṣṭha' (= kāśistha, 'living in Kāśī') moved from affiliation to residence (Kāśī); affiliation is now Mādhyandina (śākhā), surname (upanāma) Mādhya
p4 scribe: confidence lowered to low; notes now give metrically likely readings (Śrīvatsa, Śrīdhara)
notes: catalogue SAM 1741 is probably VS, i.e. about 1684 CE, but the date is not in the quoted colophon

notes: The quoted colophon gives no date. The catalogue field 'SAM 1741' must come from somewhere else in the manuscript. It is probably VS 1741, about 1684 CE, but the era is unverified. The scribe's verse (tryaṃbakatanūjena karavīranivāsinā | ... śarmaṇā lekhi ...) is corrupt. 'śrīvaḥ' is probably a corruption: Śrīvatsa or Śrīdhara would fit the metre. The catalogue reads the name as 'Śrīva Śarmā ?'. The scribe lived at Karavīra (Kolhapur), so the manuscript was probably copied outside Nepal, but no place of copying is stated. 'kāśiṣṭha' = kāśistha, describing the author's family as living in Kāśī.
